Page 55 of ''Star Wars Insider'' 47 (January 2000): Shannon Baksa in the green Light Side Mara Jade costume, captioned "LIGHT SIDE: Mara Jade, Jedi Knight." Dan Burns: "It was a really big production for just a little card, but I felt it was very important to get this one right."

Fair use of one magazine page for encyclopedia commentary on [[Mara Jade: Flesh and Blood]]. Source: Internet Archive item [https://archive.org/details/starwarsinsider_1_to_153_plus_specials starwarsinsider_1_to_153_plus_specials] (issue 047 scan).
